admission.justification: The strip and the failure-line component together realize the rule. The worker reported the duplicated prose as the cause of the developer's report — the same answer rendered in the strip and in the chat directly below it, with the strip's scroll block taken for a rendering fault — so removing the text removes both the duplication and the false fault.

applicability: The ordinary role launcher bar above the chat in the dashboard's Role chats pane.
conditions: The bar keeps its row of controls: role, agent, model, effort, Start, Result, Refresh and, where the backend allows it, Revive.
The one failure line of rule 3 and the Result-opened report of rule 4 are the only text and the only report access the strip offers.
exclusions: The chat frame and the messages it shows are outside this obligation.
A host-side rendering fault inside the embedded frame is not text under the launcher's controls.
The removed reply text is not re-offered as a shortened line, a tooltip, an aria-description or a collapsed panel.
statement: Ordinary launcher output contains controls only, without execution, reply, capability-summary or report-path prose.
